title: DevOps Engineer
description:
**Key Responsibilities** 




 1\. Containerization
 



 ● Containerize existing .NET applications (currently Windows\-hosted) using both Windows containers and Linux containers where feasible, evaluating migration paths from .NET Framework to modern .NET where applicable
 



 ● Build and maintain Dockerfiles, multi\-stage builds, and image optimization for size and security
 



 ● Establish a private container registry (Quay, Harbor, or OpenShift's internal registry) with image scanning and vulnerability management
 



 2\. Local / Office Test Environment
 



 ● Set up an on\-prem lab environment (Docker/Podman \+ a lightweight Kubernetes distro such as k3s/RKE2, or OpenShift Local/CRC) to validate containers before promotion
 



 ● Own the full inner\-loop test cycle: build → scan → run → validate → push
 



 3\. Enterprise OpenShift Deployment
 



 ● Design and deploy Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform (OCP) in the data center — cluster sizing, node roles (control plane / infra / worker), storage (ODF or Nutanix CSI), and networking (SDN/OVN\-Kubernetes)
 



 ● Own OpenShift lifecycle management: upgrades, operators, RBAC, namespaces/projects, resource quotas
 



 ● Integrate the cluster with existing Nutanix HCI infrastructure
 



 4\. CI/CD \& Environment Promotion
 



 ● Build CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, Tekton, or Azure DevOps) to move images from build through Dev, UAT, and Production
 



 ● Define and enforce environment\-specific configuration (ConfigMaps/Secrets, Vault/OpenBao integration)
 



 ● Set up UAT and Production namespaces/clusters with appropriate isolation, approval gates, and change control — important given the BFSI compliance context
 



 5\. Operations \& Reliability
 



 ● Implement monitoring and logging (Prometheus, Grafana, EFK/Loki) and alerting for containerized workloads
 



 ● Own backup/DR strategy for stateful workloads running on OpenShift
 



 ● Perform capacity planning and cost/resource optimization across clusters
 



  





**Required Skills** 




 ● 3\+ years hands\-on with Docker/Podman and Kubernetes (OpenShift preferred, or GKE/AKS/EKS with willingness to specialize in OpenShift)
 



 ● Experience containerizing .NET applications, including Windows container nuances
 



 ● Strong Linux fundamentals (RHEL preferred, given the OpenShift/Red Hat ecosystem)
 



 ● CI/CD pipeline design and scripting (Bash/PowerShell/Python)
 



 ● Networking fundamentals: ingress/routes, load balancing, and basic service mesh concepts
 



 ● Familiarity with secrets management, RBAC, and image security scanning
 



  





**Preferred / Nice\-to\-Have** 




 ● Red Hat certifications (RHCSA, EX280 – OpenShift Administration)
 



 ● Experience in BFSI/regulated environments (audit trails, change management, data residency)
 



 ● Experience with Nutanix HCI or other on\-prem virtualization
 



 ● Exposure to service mesh (Istio/OpenShift Service Mesh) and GitOps (ArgoCD/OpenShift GitOps)

We prohibit Discrimination and Harassment of any kind and our policies promote equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants, irrespective of, but not limited to their gender, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, colour, national origin, age, religion, social status, mental or physical disabilities, veteran status etc. As a global Bank, we truly believe that inclusion and diversity of our teams is key to our success in serving our clients and the communities we operate in.
